subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>: Ulfgar Fireforge, the dwarven warrior and defensive vanguard, visually defined by <Picture 1>; preserve his compact heavily armored build, braided red beard, engraved plate armor, sword, and massive rune-covered tower shield.
<Subject 2>: Thorhal, the Nordic battle bard, visually defined by <Picture 2>; preserve his face, long blond braided hair, facial markings, fur-trimmed green clothing, layered leather-and-mail equipment, sword, and decorated war horn.
<Subject 3>: Marek, the southern paladin, visually defined by <Picture 3>; preserve his tall muscular build, dark complexion, braided ponytail, dark steel plate armor, black-gold cloak, and distinctive two-handed glaive.
<Subject 4>: Nicodemus, the high elven wizard, visually defined by <Picture 4>; preserve his slender build, silver hair, pointed ears, blue-and-gold robes, spellbook satchel, and his massive spellbook as the main casting focus, floating beside him when he prepares magic.
<Subject 5>: a raiding force of twenty to thirty goblins, visually defined by <Picture 5>; maintain their hunched silhouettes, green skin, long ears, crude scavenged armor, leather wraps, and varied axes, spears, shields, daggers, and bows.
<Subject 6>: the dungeon’s final main chamber, visually defined by <Picture 6>; preserve its monumental ruined stone architecture, central circular dais, carved pillars, wall recesses, hanging chains, cages, broken floor stones, damp surfaces, and sparse torchlight.
<Subject 7>: the entrance threshold of the chamber, part of <Picture 6>; preserve the heavy stone doorway, short approach from the corridor, and the fact that it can serve as a narrow defensible choke point.

summary:
[reference generation] Create a twenty-second photorealistic dark-fantasy sequence in which the four heroes cautiously reach the final hall, stop at the entrance as soon as they detect goblins, hold the doorway as a defensive position, and end in a clear face-off with a goblin battle line forming in front of them. 

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved - preserves Ulfgar’s identity, armor, sword, beard, and runed tower-shield design.
<Picture 2>: fully_preserved - preserves Thorhal’s identity, clothing, equipment, sword, and war horn.
<Picture 3>: fully_preserved - preserves Marek’s identity, armor, cloak, and glaive.
<Picture 4>: fully_preserved - preserves Nicodemus’s identity, robes, satchel, elven features, and the massive floating spellbook as his casting focus.
<Picture 5>: attribute_transfer - supplies the goblins’ anatomy, silhouette language, scavenged equipment, weapon variety, and aggressive behavior across a group of twenty to thirty enemies.
<Picture 6>: fully_preserved - preserves the main chamber’s architecture, scale, floor layout, entrance zone, and lighting logic while allowing new character blocking and camera angles.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic medieval dark fantasy with realistic armor weight, cloth movement, damp stone textures, torchlight, and cool ambient gloom from above. The entire sequence is a tense four-shot scene in which the heroes never advance into the center of the chamber; they stop at the entrance and hold that choke point for the entire confrontation.

[Shot 1] A low medium-wide tracking shot moves backward from inside the hall toward the doorway as the party approaches. <Subject 1> Ulfgar enters first and takes only two careful steps past <Subject 7>, staying just inside the threshold in the front-center position. His shield is raised directly in front of him and his sword is held behind its image-left edge. <Subject 3> Marek follows immediately behind and slightly image-right of Ulfgar, one half-step back, carrying the glaive diagonally upward so it clears the doorway. <Subject 4> Nicodemus enters behind Ulfgar on image-left, still within one step of the doorway. <Subject 2> Thorhal enters behind Marek on image-right, also staying close to the threshold. All four move slowly and cautiously, scanning the darkness before committing further.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, cut to a wide side angle from deeper inside the chamber looking toward the entrance. The heroes stop immediately at the doorway instead of moving farther into the hall. Ulfgar turns his shield squarely toward the open chamber and plants himself at the center of the entrance line. Marek shifts to Ulfgar’s image-right shoulder, still half a step behind, lowering his glaive into a ready guard that projects forward past Ulfgar’s shield line. Nicodemus holds the back-left corner of the formation, just inside the doorway, where his massive spellbook lifts from its satchel, opens, and begins floating beside him at shoulder height with pages turning on their own. Thorhal takes the back-right corner of the formation, sword drawn, body angled outward to watch the right flank while keeping the doorway formation intact. It is clear they have chosen to hold the entrance as a defensible choke point.

[Shot 3] At 00:10.500, cut to a high wide frontal view facing the heroes from inside the chamber. Goblins begin appearing only in front of them: from behind pillars, from broken side passages farther ahead, from wall recesses along the chamber’s front half, and from rubble around the central hall. More shapes gather until twenty to thirty goblins are visible across the chamber’s forward half, but none move behind the heroes and none occupy the corridor behind them. The space directly behind the heroes remains open as the doorway back into the corridor. The goblins form a rough advancing crescent several meters in front of the entrance, then settle into a looser battle line facing the heroes rather than surrounding them. Spearmen come forward near the center, shield-bearers bunch near the front, dagger-wielders hover behind, and archers hold slightly back on the flanks.

[Shot 4] At 00:15.500, cut to a dramatic ground-level medium-wide shot from inside the chamber facing the heroes head-on. The doorway is directly behind them and clearly visible in frame as a stone opening into the darker corridor, making it obvious they are still holding the entrance. Ulfgar stands front-center at the threshold with his shield locked forward, feet planted wide on the doorway stones. Marek stands just behind and to Ulfgar’s image-right, glaive leveled over and past the shield line toward the goblins. Nicodemus stands back-left inside the doorway, massive spellbook floating open beside him while pale arcane light gathers around his casting hand. Thorhal stands back-right inside the doorway with sword ready and his free hand near the war horn, guarding the formation’s right rear edge. In front of them, five to eight meters away, the foremost goblins form a clear hostile front line stretching across the chamber. More goblins cluster behind them in depth. They do not encircle the heroes. They face the party directly, hissing and snarling, weapons raised, bodies crouched and ready to spring. End at 00:20.000 on this locked standoff: the four heroes braced in the doorway, the goblin battle line massed in front of them, and the first clash still one heartbeat away.

overall_soundscape:
Deep dungeon ambience with dripping water, distant air movement through stone passages, faint chain creaks, and torch crackle. The heroes’ approach is heard through careful bootsteps, armor movement, leather creaks, and Ulfgar’s shield settling into position at the threshold. As the goblins reveal themselves, the room fills with claws scraping stone, scattered feet on rubble, shield knocks, bowstrings tightening, and a mounting wall of hisses, snarls, and harsh goblin chatter concentrated in front of the doorway.

non_diegetic_music:
A tense orchestral suspense cue begins with low strings and distant drum pulses. As the heroes stop at the threshold, the score tightens with deeper cellos, soft metallic percussion, and restrained low brass. In the final shot, the music rises into a held pre-battle crescendo, sustaining pressure without resolving into full combat.
